package rulefixtures

import (
	"bytes"
	"compress/gzip"
	"io"
)

// scenario for gzip_reader_writer_recreated_per_item: gzip.NewReader(...) or gzip.NewWriter(...) recreated inside iterative paths instead of per stream.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.
func scenario351Positive(payloads []string) ([]string, error) {
	var results []string
	for _, p := range payloads {
		var buf bytes.Buffer
		gw := gzip.NewWriter(&buf)
		gw.Write([]byte(p))
		gw.Close()

		gr, err := gzip.NewReader(&buf)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		data, err := io.ReadAll(gr)
		gr.Close()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		results = append(results, string(data))
	}
	return results, nil
}
